findings.title: reviewed-new lifecycle is not cross-checked against phases, durations, or retention
findings.detail: The arm enforces the lifecycle enum and only forces null handler/dispatch durations for raised and pending_at_stop. It does not require completed to have a truthful completed response/duration state, returned_without_response to have no observed http_response, or retention.final_request.outcome to equal summary.lifecycle. A summary can therefore carry contradictory lifecycle, phase, duration, and final-retention values while passing the strict validator. The frozen handoff explicitly defines lifecycle derivation and retention as the same request outcome.
